🌊 Liquidity Update

The market is pricing possible policy relief before actual liquidity has improved. That distinction matters. Risk assets can stay resilient while the underlying funding system remains selective, but resilience is not the same as a broad monetary impulse.

💵

The global financial system is running out of slack, and nobody seems to be talking about it loudly enough. For years, the Fed’s Reverse Repo Facility (RRP) acted as a massive sponge, absorbing excess liquidity from money market funds and keeping overnight rates pinned near zero.
